notes.title: Final release 1.2 with Linux support and new Boss
notes.notes:
With the new 1.2 version we are out of early access.

 New boss Klonarg added
 Multiple bug fixes including menu selection issues.
 Linux version is now available.

notes.title: Release 1.17 New boss battle, more swarms, and a level select.
notes.notes: The game now has a concept of a job board so that you can go right where you want.  The new boss battle is intense and massive drone swarms make it even more challenging.  Also destroying massive amounts of drones is so satisfying that we decided to add a lot more of them.

notes.title: Release 1.15 Available Now! Complete redesign with loads of new enhancements.
notes.notes:
Version 1.15 offers a complete redesign with lots of new features, art, and music. Here are some of the highlights in this release:


 New enemies with an enemy management system that allows for increased intensity that flows with the game play.
 Power ups that increase player's abilities to meet the intensity curve.
 Enhanced performance enables more in-game enemies and bullets.
 New artwork and added selective coloring for an overall improved aesthetic appeal.
 Custom music
 Random generated levels
 New strike attack game mechanic.
 A lot more sound effects and variations on these effects.
 New drone swarms with better drone to drone separation.
 Added In game hints and instructions that are quick to read.
 Objective tracker allows you to quickly find the objective.
 Boss battle focused game play.
 Health restore areas for when you are really needing it.
 Intensity curve that gets you into the action right away without overwhelming too quickly.
 A lot of different bullets, lasers, and rockets were added to the enemy arsenal.
